cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've authorized an inquiry into the two missing office biscuits. This has the shape of an organized operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ate them. Can we close the inquiry?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closure is denied. A confession that quick suggests training. You may explain who prepared you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. I was hungry. Can I go to lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lunch is approved under my observation. If they're recruiting through hunger, I need to see who supplies your sandwich.
